judgments.yea_description: Voted to send H.J.Res. 35 to the President, using the Congressional Review Act to repeal the EPA rule implementing the waste emissions charge on methane released by oil and gas facilities. It passed the Senate 52-47.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 35 to the President, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the EPA rule implementing the waste emissions charge on methane released by oil and gas facilities. It passed the Senate 52-47.
